queries.sql: SELECT qb.id AS question_id, qb.subject_id, qb.question_title, qs.question_set_id, -- Aggregate all options as JSON JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'question_id', qo.question_id, 'question_answer_id', qo.question_answer_id, 'question_option', qo.question_option, 'correct_answer', qo.correct_answer ) ) AS options, -- Student's selected answer ID (NULL if not answered) qa.your_answer_id, -- Student's answer text (NULL if not answered) (SELECT question_option FROM question_option WHERE question_answer_id = qa.your_answer_id LIMIT 1) AS your_answer_text, -- Correct answer text (SELECT question_option FROM question_option WHERE question_id = qb.id AND correct_answer = '1' LIMIT 1) AS correct_answer_text FROM question_set qs INNER JOIN question_bank qb ON qb.id = qs.question_id LEFT JOIN question_option qo ON qo.question_id = qb.id LEFT JOIN question_answer qa ON qa.question_id = qb.id AND qa.user_id = 'STD25344B7F3D' WHERE qs.subject_id = 'EXAM-25335D8B66' AND qs.question_set_id = 'QSet-001' GROUP BY qb.id, qb.subject_id, qb.question_title, qs.question_set_id ORDER BY qb.id
